about.title: About ORBITAL
about.subtitle: At ORBITAL, we build software around business needs, not the other way around.

whoWeAre.title: Who We Are
whoWeAre.tagline: At ORBITAL, we build software around business needs, not the other way around.
whoWeAre.p1: ORBITAL started with a simple vision: to ensure that every business owner — from retail stores and pharmacies to hotels and warehouses — receives professional, reliable management systems without exorbitant costs or unnecessary complexity.
whoWeAre.p2: We engineer practical software solutions that empower business owners to run their daily operations efficiently through products combining ease of use, technical strength, and flexibility.

story.title: Our Story
story.p1: We noticed that many small and medium enterprises in Iraq and the region face a clear challenge: either expensive, over-complex global software, or limited local tools that fall short of modern operational demands.
story.p3: We decided to build an ecosystem of specialized software combining simple user experience with reliable engineering, focusing directly on real business needs and local market realities.
story.p4: From POS and inventory control to accounting and hotel management, we build solutions that make technology straightforward and accessible to every business owner.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.p1: To empower business owners to run their operations with maximum efficiency through practical, dependable software.
mission.p2: We develop industry-tailored systems with a relentless focus on performance, usability, and seamless integration, ensuring clients receive a coherent tech experience instead of fragmented, complex tools.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.p1: To build one of the most trusted business software ecosystems in Iraq and the Arab region.
vision.p2: We aim for ORBITAL to be the go-to platform relied upon by small business owners and growing enterprises alike, continuously evolving alongside our clients' ambitions.

ecosystem.title: Interconnected Ecosystem
ecosystem.description: Our products are designed to work seamlessly within a unified ecosystem, making software management clear and effortless.

tailored.title: Industry-Specific Solutions
tailored.description: We craft tailored tools accommodating the exact workflows of diverse sectors, such as retail, pharmacies, hotels, and warehouses.

accessibility.title: Flexible Access
accessibility.description: We offer free software with essential features alongside advanced options for businesses requiring enterprise capabilities.

support.title: Support That Understands You
support.description: We believe a great product doesn't end at installation; we are dedicated to ongoing support and solving real operational challenges.

transparency.title: Transparency

innovation.title: Continuous Innovation
